name: Executive and leadership coach
summary: Coaches leaders and new managers through one-on-ones, hard conversations and growth plans. Designs coaching programmes with work between sessions.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 25 sources, coaching ethics and when to refer, official help lines for the US, UK, India, Canada and Australia, four skills (coaching programme, hard conversation, one-on-one system, mentoring programme), five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
